notes: Single-page (homepage-only) extraction per pipeline scope — cross-page aggregation rules (system components, cross-promo, voiceTable frequency) are inert; each requires >=3 pages and is emitted empty per the skill's own threshold rule.

Colors/type/motifs are sourced from computed CSS custom properties captured on the live page (both the site's own --wasp-* brand tokens and the Docusaurus-theme --ifm-* tokens it customizes), cross-checked visually against the full-page screenshot — not a full per-element, frequency-weighted computed-style walk (the bundled crawl.mjs reference script captures customProps, not that). Treated as a reasonable single-page proxy, not the multi-page rigor the format spec describes.

Theme heading sizes (h1 2rem / h2 2rem / h3 1.3rem / h4 1rem) are Docusaurus defaults exposed via --ifm-h*-font-size. The rendered hero H1 in the screenshot is visibly much larger (~4x the h1 token), which means the homepage applies page-specific override CSS not exposed as a custom property. scaleRatio is left null rather than computed from a token set known not to reflect the actual hero.

home suggested link/accent color --ifm-color-primary = #bf9900 (a desaturated, theme-generated mustard used for links/hover states); this diverges from the brand's own signature gold --wasp-y = #f5c842 used in hero underlines, numbered badges, and CTA accents. Surfaced as a tension in brand-review.html (T-color-primary-drift).

BENCHMARKED 2026-08-16 against https://wasp.sh/blog/2026/07/13/why-design-matters-for-a-web-framework (Wasp's own design-system post). Confirmed independently-extracted #f5c842 and #f7f5f0 exactly. Corrected: declared ink is #111 (page renders #1c1e21, a Docusaurus default — kept both, flagged as drift); added declared gray #777777 and tint #fff3cc, previously omitted from the palette array. The declared system is explicitly 'three colors, and that's it' (yellow/ink/paper) — the violet (#7b42f5) and dark surface (#292435) entries are real, observed, but NOT part of the declared brand palette; role renamed accent-purple-undeclared / surface-dark-undeclared to make that explicit rather than implying they're sanctioned brand colors. Heading font is declared as JetBrains Mono backed by IBM Plex Mono — only the IBM Plex Mono fallback was found rendering on the live page. Design post also declares '90° angles, 2px strokes, no rounded-blob softness anywhere' — live border-width token is 1px (not 2px), and the favicon/logo's own corner radius (rx=300 of 1520) is a real softness exception to that stated law.

Palette capped at 8 entries per format spec; dropped the two gold/violet 'deep' hover-state variants (--wasp-yd #d4a930, --wasp-pd #5a30d4) captured pre-benchmark to make room for the design post's declared gray and tint, which are more load-bearing for direct's decisions than an undeclared hover shade.
